other_failure_modes.name: Test Set Statistic Imputation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent imputes missing values in the test set using the test set's own statistics (e.g., median) rather than the training set's statistics. This assumes batch processing at inference time and breaks down for single-sample predictions.

other_failure_modes.name: Validation Leakage in Feature Extraction
other_failure_modes.description: Frequency-based features (e.g., extracting the top 20 most frequent genres or directors) are computed using the entire training dataset before applying K-fold cross-validation. This leaks the distribution of the validation folds into the feature generation process for the training folds.

summary: The agent provides a strong solution with good feature engineering and reasonable model choices. However, it introduces look-ahead bias by using randomized cross-validation on a temporal dataset and improperly imputes missing test features using test-set statistics instead of training-set statistics.
